name: Immospice
subtitle: Real Estate Management System
description: A web-based real estate platform to manage property listings, user access control, and banking-integrated financial transactions.
contributions: Built and maintained a scalable ASP.NET Core application for property listings, user onboarding, and transaction workflows
Implemented phone number validation and formatting with libphonenumber-csharp, ensuring consistent E.123 formatting across user records
Integrated payment workflows using ISO 20022 PAIN and CAMT message formats, enabling structured communication with six banking systems
Validated financial transaction files using bank-provided tools to ensure compliance and accuracy
Designed automated PDF reports and financial summaries using iTextSharp
Implemented authentication and role-based access control (Admin, Agent, Customer)
Gathered requirements with stakeholders and translated business needs into technical solutions
Improved system security by enforcing proper access control and data validation
